newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Recticel, Greiner expand scope of cooperation.
newsitem.headline: Recticel, Greiner expand scope of cooperation.

text.p: Belgian foam products group Recticel said on Tuesday it would expand the scope of activities of its 50/50 Eurofoam joint venture with Austria's Greiner Group.

Eurofoam would buy the comfort and technical foam production and converting activities of Greiner in Austria, spread over four locations, and the foaming and converting activities of Recticel and Greiner in Germany, spread over 12 locations.

The extended joint venture, set up in 1992, would comprise eight foaming plants and 19 converting plants in seven countries, with estimated 1997 sales of nine billion Belgian francs and a staff 1,700.
The merger would create the necessary synergies to allow Eurofoam to react quicker to growing customer demands and gain flexibility in logistics and production capabilities.
Recticel would remain present in Germany and Austria with the production of automotive, bedding and insulation products.
The two companies expect the extended venture to be operational in the spring of this year.
The merger requires European Commission approval.
